module: Centralized sorting of gameplay selector tiles. Provides four modes (Name, System, GameplayAutomatic, Date), the conversion of UI values ('name', 'automatic', 'date', 'system') to these modes and a fallback to 'Name' for any invalid value (with a warning log).
notes: System order (SYSTEM_ORDER): freeroam 1, quickStartExperiences 2, challenges 3, scenarios 4, scenariosMultiplayer 5, campaigns 6, 'Other...' 7; unknown system = 999 (in GameplayAutomatic).
Name: alphabetical sort on Name, name or label; the item whose name equals _tr('ui.menu.gridSelector.other') always goes last.
GameplayAutomatic: tiles from clustering first (by name), then system order, then non-auxiliary before auxiliary, then the order property (missing = math.huge), then name.
Date: most recent first; no date last; ties are sorted by name.
BUG: sortByGameplayAutomatic uses OTHER_PLACEHOLDER, a global variable that is never defined (nil), so a missing system gives nil; the effect is the same as 999 because SYSTEM_ORDER[nil] is nil.
BUG: the "Challenges" branch compares with a capital letter while the system is named 'challenges'; it is therefore never taken (the career sort compareCareerStatus is unused).
In sortBySystem, an unknown system is placed after the known systems; if both are unknown and different, the function returns false.

SYSTEM_ORDER.desc: Rank of each gameplay system for sorting.

UI_TO_SORT_MODE.desc: UI value -> internal mode mapping (name, automatic, date, system).

SORT_MODE_TO_UI.desc: Reverse mapping, computed at load time.

getSortFunction.desc: Returns the comparison function for a mode. Invalid or unknown mode: warning log and fallback to 'Name'.

returns.desc: function(a, b) -> boolean usable by table.sort.

isValidSortMode.desc: Returns whether the sort mode exists.

convertUIValueToSortMode.desc: Converts a UI value to an internal mode; 'Name' if nil, non-string or unknown (with a warning).

sortTilesFromUIValue.desc: Sorts the tile list in place from a UI value.

sortTiles.desc: Sorts the tile list in place (table.sort) with the given internal mode.

sortByNameButOtherAlwaysLast.desc: Alphabetical comparator, with the "Other" item always last.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

sortBySystem.desc: Comparator by system order, then by name when systems are equal.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

sortByGameplayAutomatic.desc: Multi-criteria comparator: clusters, system, auxiliary, order, name.

a.desc: Tile or item (isClustered, system, isAuxiliary, order, name).

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

sortByDate.desc: Comparator by descending date; no date last; name on ties.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

sortGroup.desc: Sorts group.tiles in place with the given mode.
